headline: Thailand Central Bank Cuts Consumption Forecast Amid Weakening Labor Market
summary: The Bank of Thailand lowered its private consumption growth forecast to 2.3% for the year, warning it could drop to 1.6% without government co-payment support as job conditions soften.
why: Central bank forecasts provide critical insight into domestic economic momentum, consumer spending health, and potential monetary policy shifts.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Weaker consumption forecasts point to a slowing domestic economy.
